defects.description: Description says Extend the far arm OUTWARD for visual length and counterbalance. leftElbow=40 (bent 40°) shortens the arm visually. Should be near-straight (8° minimum) for full extension.

spine=26 is described as steep diagonal. Could be steeper (30-35°) to better convey steepness. leftShoulder=-60 puts arm at 85° abduction (just past lateral); extending to -75 brings arm fully horizontal for visual length.

failing_tests.assertion: leftShoulder <= -70 for fully extended outward arm

regression_risk: low — single-pose 2-field change; arm extends straighter and slightly higher, no other joint affected
rationale: CORRECTED CONVENTION: leftShoulder rotZ, - = raise arm up/overhead. Description: Extend the far arm OUTWARD for visual LENGTH and counterbalance. Currently leftElbow=40 bends the forearm, shortening visual length. Setting leftElbow=10 (renderer enforces 8° soft minimum, so effectively straight) for full extension. Raising leftShoulder from -60 to -75 brings arm from 85° to ~105° abduction — fully horizontal, maximizing visual length. Keeping spine=26 (forward diagonal lean) and leftHip=-10 (left foot back for steep diagonal stance).
